verdict.rationale: Missive's MCP integration page says users can 'connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI Copilot' via 'Custom MCP', entering a name, server URL and authentication method, so the assistant can use internal tools and systems. It also ships ready-made MCP integrations for Notion, Linear, Attio and Lindy.ai, running on the user's own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini key. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom MCP client working, and documentation of supported transports and per-tool permission/approval controls.
